name: Riya
source:
A young man who has absolute confidence in his violin talent. He has no interest in others, and has a personality that sticks to his own path. 

He wants to leave town as soon as possible. Rumor has it that he and Akifumi have a bad relationship.

[Translated and edited from [url=http://b-cluster.eek.jp/requartz/character/riya.html]official website[/url]]
